source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: If header parsing fails, the mailbox parser must still move to body state and advance its byte position. Staying in header state can buffer the entire body indefinitely, leading to memory growth or a state-machine trap.
title: Advance mailbox parser state even after header parsing fails
